architecture_decisions:
:
- 5.1 Coherent production implementation unit `AgenticControlPlane._work_graph()` must return one `WorkUnit` for ordinary implementation generation regardless of whether acceptance text contains client, server, data, browser, endpoint, schema, persistence, or other keyword domains. The unit must: - have stable server-owned identity `implementation`; - own exactly `tuple(item["id"] for item in acceptance)` in approved order; - retain `work_kind="implementation"`; - retain the existing `bounded-source-evidence` capability requirement; - retain one source evidence reference bound to the accepted source digest; - remain non-authoritative for canonical mutation.

critique:
The production source-authoring work graph contains exactly one implementation work unit for one approved Work Specification execution. The coherent work unit owns the exact ordered approved acceptance ID set. Acceptance-text keyword classification must not split canonical source authoring into client/server/data work units. The smallest-capable-team planner therefore selects one initial implementation agent; remaining eligible hosted agents remain available only through the existing bounded candidate-recovery path. At most the existing one final validator repair remains available after distinct eligible agents are exhausted. P2-V0.23.27 per-generation incremental patch retention remains available within the coherent work unit. P2-V0.23.28 plan-prefix convergence remains a compatibility/defense-in-depth path but is not exercised by ordinary production source authoring because there is no multi-unit source proposal to assemble. No retry budget, timeout, provider roster, source authority, mutation authority, deployment authority, lifecycle authority, or REVIEW authority is…
